notes: Restores the phone Voice Controller's manual start fallback. Tapping the large 'Say Hey Jarvis' button now always starts a conversation, even when the wake model is loaded but not detecting the phrase; previously that click was silently ignored whenever the model claimed to be available. Adds honest wake-detector diagnostics showing either the real inference error or the best score versus the configured threshold, and marks the remote wake model unavailable after repeated inference failures so manual start remains usable. Automatic wake detection is still being diagnosed; this release does not claim that issue is fixed. Includes the 1.9.21 host fallback when phone capture stalls.
